verdict.rationale: Synctera provides programmatic KYC/KYB verification objects for both personal and business customers with identity and watchlist screening, document verification, PROSPECT/ACTIVE application states, enhanced due diligence for high-risk cases, and sandbox test cases covering multiple verification flows. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of verification accuracy and no explicit enumeration of all possible application/customer states beyond PROSPECT/ACTIVE.
